basic_profile.bio: I'm a 25-year-old gamer from New Jersey, currently working as a graphic designer. I have a deep passion for video games, especially Genshin Impact, which I play almost daily. I also love watching YouTube videos, particularly those by NakeyJakey. I'm a big fan of the New York Giants and enjoy discussing games and sports with fellow enthusiasts. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work, around 7 PM to 11 PM EST. I'm single and enjoy spending my weekends exploring new gaming strategies or catching up on the latest Giants games.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in digital art and design, having graduated with a degree in Graphic Design from a local community college. My love for video games has led me to self-teach game design principles, focusing primarily on design aesthetics and user experience. I tend to visit subreddits that offer insights and tips on improving my gaming skills.
